newsitem.title: GERMANY: French express group Axor opens new German offices.
newsitem.headline: French express group Axor opens new German offices.

text.p: French express freight operator Axor said it has opened three new freight centres in Germany.
Offices in Berlin, Nuremberg and Hanover have been added to the firm's Kassel hub and existing branches in Frankfurt, Munich, Hamburg, Stuttgart and Ratingen, a statement said.
The new centres were part of the group's strategy of increasing its Germany presence under general European expansion plans, it added.
Axor, the European division of French express group Jet Services, operates a nightly Fokker-27 flight from Kassel to Paris with two tonnes of freight capacity.
